name: Lockspoke
summary: Account security for a small bike company, scored on a wheel with one spoke per person
about: A complete account security app for an eighteen-person bike company, in bold sand, tomato and navy blocks with a light and a dark theme. The security score is a bicycle wheel whose spokes turn green as each person gets 2-step sign-in, a strong password and safe devices, and a fix-next list does the work in one click. People, devices, app access, shared passwords, sign-in alerts, phishing practice and policies each have their own page.
how: Watch the wheel spin in on the overview; click a spoke to see that person and what they still need.
Press Fix on items in the Fix next list, or Fix the top item; spokes light up and the score climbs.
Offboard someone who left, turn on 2-step for everyone, reset passwords and add new staff.
Push updates, lock or wipe devices, and tick boxes in the access matrix to grant or remove app access.
Run a leak check on shared passwords and change one; the new password is hidden until you press Show.
Triage sign-in alerts: take them, assign an owner, then resolve as It was them or Block and reset.
Send a phishing practice test, assign lessons, and set password length and device rules under Policies.
